title: Changing course and letting meaning grow

captions.physics: Finding a new course within change
captions.emotions: Pleasure in care and living growth

meaning: Attentive understanding of hidden meaning can inspire you when changed shared participation brings pleasure in care and living growth.
text: The High Priestess in the energy of Sahasrara supports attentive interest in meaning that does not reveal itself immediately. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position appears through shared actions amid changing circumstances: noticing another course and adjusting participation while retaining what matters. The Empress in emotions brings pleasure in care, growth and living response. Continuing meaningful inquiry may feel close to you both so new conditions also help others encounter their own experience and develop it usefully. Change becomes a contribution beyond your relationship through what people are actually able to notice and continue.

For example, rain changes plans for a walk through old courtyards. Together you move the gathering to a library and invite attentive examination of photographs people brought. **A new course can give still-hidden meaning room to grow.** Someone notices a family detail and brings another photograph next time. A living response feels rewarding as changed participation helps memory continue through attention the earlier quick route might not have invited.

Difficulty arises if each new possibility changes the entire arrangement. Participants cannot understand how to continue the inquiry. An attentive motive and pleasure in growth remain supportive. Shared action benefits from retaining recognisable connections between steps so people know where their interest has moved and can encounter it again.
